arguments.decision: Which extension best closes the observed eligibility gap while preserving treatment-neutral craftsmanship and independent dimensions?

candidates.description: Add essential narrow reference-relative craft gates for controlled construction, edge refinement, material realization, hierarchy, proportion and lighting; separate semantic fit gates for brand specificity, meaningful visual synthesis, constraint fidelity and concept strength. Require all settled passes, inspect small flat/hero views and native detail crops. Keep preference and GPU policy separate.
Raise pleasantness and the overall quality probability threshold without changing the current question set.
Require complex geometry, highly glossy materials and many decorative details to match the Chief examples.
Keep the current craft form/surface/detail checks and literal symbol/appearance checks, with uncertainty blocked.

arguments.evidence: Owner approved both restrained/muted and glossy/reflective/rounder Chief treatments as high craft; neither is universally preferred. Owner rejected Skill Swap studies. New held-out Rootshare matte terracotta sprout rendered with verified Metal-only tracing and OIDN Metal denoising at 4000->2000. Current actual image judgments: literal symbol pass and appearance pass; craft unsettled; aliasing unsettled. Owner explicitly judged Rootshare both below craft floor and below brief fit. The user now asks for more and stricter criteria, and a chain of several Jev calls to help extend them.
arguments.priorities: Demand reference-level execution and meaningful fit for each brand's own brief. Avoid default copying of palette, geometry, material or finish. No aggregate compensations for essential failures. Missing/uncertain/API/device outcomes must remain explicit. GPUs are operational, not aesthetic. More gloss/complexity is not automatically better.
requirements: Reject generic literal depiction when it lacks a developed brand-specific visual idea.
Permit restrained and glossy treatments of equally accomplished execution.
Keep craftsmanship independent from semantic/appearance fit and preference.

context.text: Craft, all essential and reference-relative: contours/joins, controlled surfaces, resolved detail, intentional proportion, visual hierarchy, clean edge transitions, convincing intended-material construction, readable controlled lighting. Fit, all essential and own-brief-only: visible symbol match, intended appearance, a developed brand-specific visual idea beyond a stock category icon, purposeful synthesis of shapes into the brand promise, compliance with avoid/direction, immediate communicative clarity. Small-size evidence: recognizable shared core motif in flat 32px and hero 32px; secondary hero lettering need not remain readable at favicon size. Technical image judgment receives full image plus four delivered-resolution quadrants (not downscaled thumbnails alone). Each Noul is independent; essential uncertain stays review-needed; a failed criterion cannot be compensated by appeal. Same existing yes/no bands, more substantive requirements. Both presentation orders, model/source/rubric hashes, owner labels recorded separately.

Rootshare literal sprout and terracotta appearance passed under the earlier rubric, but owner judged both craftsmanship and brief fit below floor. Both Chief finishes are owner-approved craft positives; Skill Swap overall rejection does not identify every per-dimension defect.

propositions: The proposed brand-specific-idea check addresses the observed gap where literal motif match passed but the owner rejected brief fit.
The proposed craftsmanship checks permit a restrained matte treatment to pass without copying the glossy reference material.
Native-resolution quadrant evidence supplies detail that a downscaled whole image alone may conceal.
The proposed small-size rule preserves the distinction between the core motif and secondary hero lettering.
The proposed all-essential-pass rule can still choose a candidate solely because a forced preference Choice favors it.

notes: Exploratory rubric-design judgments, not actual-image qualification or owner approval.
The 0.73 treatment-neutrality judgment remained uncertain; expanded image calibration is retained separately.
